description: Replace newly added Application.get_env usage in outbound HTTP code with Zaq.Config and move direct HTTP client test seams behind explicit config stubs instead of raw per-call runtime overrides.

comments.text: Replaced HttpClient Application.get_env usage with Zaq.Config.get(:zaq, __MODULE__, [], opts). Removed the test_opts_enabled Application env gate. Updated HTTP client and credential tests to inject test seams through explicit ConfigStub modules via opts[:config], preserving production Channels.Api behavior where event opts are not forwarded. Verified no direct Application.get_env/http_client_test_opts_enabled usage remains in HttpClient. Focused tests passed: 109 tests, 0 failures. mix q passed with Credo no issues.

Fixed follow-up test regressions: updated stale authorization-header message assertion and rewrote the real Channels.Api boundary test to use application-level HttpClient config rather than the removed event opts http_module bypass. Focused suites passed: 124 tests, 0 failures. mix q passed.

title: Use Zaq.Config for outbound HTTP test seams
